limits: No ztty or clipboard timing in this script
vared stores the pasted text in a variable without execution
ZLE redraw hook completion is not visible display completion
master write completion means kernel acceptance, not child receipt

actual_desktop.scope: New owned session from the selected desktop command on the actual desktop

rendering_path.basis: Renderer property and reported GL driver string; this is not GPU utilization, VRAM or physical-display performance measurement.

broker_xres_pixmaps.scope: server PIXMAP resources attributed to the window's X client; not total GPU/driver/font memory

actual_desktop.memory_scope: Whole selected broker process and its X client; may include other user sessions. These are not per-window or isolated-run counters.

limitations: Memory baseline and final measurements use private Xvfb with forced software OpenGL; hardware desktop is one final-build snapshot without a paired baseline.
XRes bytes are not whole-process RSS/PSS or total GPU memory. Do not add XRes again to X-server PSS.
Clipboard staging and shell editing are separate experiments. No shell paste speedup is claimed.
Runtime candidate is fixed; documentation-only descendants do not change the accepted executable.
Screenshots, ELF files and compressed logs remain outside Git according to docs/artifact-storage.md.
